items.problem: Migrated app rendered in light theme while the UWP golden was captured in dark theme.
items.evidence: score discrepancies.json 'theme' item ('reflects the host system theme, not a migration defect'); parity/winui3/screenshots/00_launch.png.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — not a skill concern; this is host system theme at capture time, not anything the migration controls.
items.why_no_skill_change: The theme is determined by the host OS at runtime, not by the migration output. No skill edit could or should change it; layout/controls/nav all matched the UWP structure.
